# OKISO

> OKISO is an independent virtual artist and VOCALOID producer creating original hyperpop and electronic music, live content, and connected release projects.

## Start here

- [Home](https://okiso.net): artist identity, latest release, featured videos, live status, and official channels.
- [About OKISO](https://okiso.net/about): artist profile, official channels and business contact.
- [Releases](https://okiso.net/releases): complete public discography and release details.
- [Gallery](https://okiso.net/gallery): commissioned artwork, alternate versions, artist credits, and original work links.
- [Upcoming](https://okiso.net/upcoming): announced and forthcoming projects.
- [The Vault](https://okiso.net/vault): public listening room and deeper project archive.
- [Rouge & Noir](https://okiso.net/rouge-noir): an original roulette roguelike project by OKISO.
